Mom's Pasta Salad:

1 box rainbow spiral pasta

1 or 2 cans sliced black olives

~1 cup small pieces of broccoli

~1 cup small pieces of cauliflower

~1 block of marble jack cheese, cubed

1/2 pack of Hormel pepperonis, sliced in half

1/2-1 cup red onion (to taste)

2 bottles of Italian dressing

Cook and cool pasta and combine with other ingredients. Add 3/4 bottle of dressing and stir. Cover an refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Before serving, add more dressing (pasta will absorb so adding some before eating makes the flavor better). This makes a buttload of pasta salad, even when cut in half. Adjust proportions of veg and stuff as desired, measurements are just approximated, I usually eyeball everything.
